## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, deps, refactor
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` — code change without behavior change
- [ ] `test` — adding or updating tests
- [ ] `ci` — CI/CD changes

## Testing checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`make test`)
- [ ] New tests added for any new behavior
- [ ] No PHPStan errors (`make lint`)

## WordPress.org compliance

- [ ] No competitor mentions added
- [ ] No upsells or premium prompts added
- [ ] No telemetry or external data collection added
- [ ] All new user-facing strings use the `sendstack` text domain

## Documentation
